work.title: The First Part of Henry the Sixth
work.author: William Shakespeare

content.text: Enter a Messenger that meets York. Enter York with trumpet and many soldiers

lines.text: Are not the speedy scouts return'd again
lines.plainText: Are not the speedy scouts return'd again

lines.text: That dogg'd the mighty army of the Dauphin?
lines.plainText: That dogg'd the mighty army of the Dauphin

lines.text: They are return'd, my lord, and give it out
lines.plainText: They are return'd my lord and give it out

lines.text: That he is march'd to Bordeaux with his power,
lines.plainText: That he is march'd to Bordeaux with his power

lines.text: To fight with Talbot. As he march'd along,
lines.plainText: To fight with Talbot As he march'd along

lines.text: By your espials were discovered
lines.plainText: By your espials were discovered

lines.text: Two mightier troops than that the Dauphin led,
lines.plainText: Two mightier troops than that the Dauphin led

lines.text: Which join'd with him and made their march for Bordeaux.
lines.plainText: Which join'd with him and made their march for Bordeaux

lines.text: A plague upon that villain Somerset
lines.plainText: A plague upon that villain Somerset

lines.text: That thus delays my promised supply
lines.plainText: That thus delays my promised supply

lines.text: Of horsemen that were levied for this siege!
lines.plainText: Of horsemen that were levied for this siege

lines.text: Renowned Talbot doth expect my aid,
lines.plainText: Renowned Talbot doth expect my aid

lines.text: And I am louted by a traitor villain
lines.plainText: And I am louted by a traitor villain

lines.text: And cannot help the noble chevalier.
lines.plainText: And cannot help the noble chevalier

lines.text: God comfort him in this necessity!
lines.plainText: God comfort him in this necessity

lines.text: If he miscarry, farewell wars in France.
lines.plainText: If he miscarry farewell wars in France

lines.text: Thou princely leader of our English strength,
lines.plainText: Thou princely leader of our English strength

lines.text: Never so needful on the earth of France,
lines.plainText: Never so needful on the earth of France

lines.text: Spur to the rescue of the noble Talbot,
lines.plainText: Spur to the rescue of the noble Talbot

lines.text: Who now is girdled with a waist of iron,
lines.plainText: Who now is girdled with a waist of iron

lines.text: And hemm'd about with grim destruction.
lines.plainText: And hemm'd about with grim destruction

lines.text: To Bordeaux, warlike Duke! To Bordeaux, York!
lines.plainText: To Bordeaux warlike Duke To Bordeaux York

lines.text: Else farewell, Talbot, France, and England's honour.
lines.plainText: Else farewell Talbot France and England's honour

lines.text: O God, that Somerset, who in proud heart
lines.plainText: O God that Somerset who in proud heart

lines.text: Doth stop my cornets, were in Talbot's place!
lines.plainText: Doth stop my cornets were in Talbot's place

lines.text: So should we save a valiant gentleman
lines.plainText: So should we save a valiant gentleman

lines.text: By forfeiting a traitor and a coward.
lines.plainText: By forfeiting a traitor and a coward

lines.text: Mad ire and wrathful fury makes me weep
lines.plainText: Mad ire and wrathful fury makes me weep

lines.text: That thus we die while remiss traitors sleep.
lines.plainText: That thus we die while remiss traitors sleep

lines.text: O, send some succour to the distress'd lord!
lines.plainText: O send some succour to the distress'd lord

lines.text: He dies, we lose; I break my warlike word;
lines.plainText: He dies we lose I break my warlike word

lines.text: We mourn, France smiles; we lose, they daily get,
lines.plainText: We mourn France smiles we lose they daily get

lines.text: All long of this vile traitor Somerset.
lines.plainText: All long of this vile traitor Somerset

lines.text: Then God take mercy on brave Talbot's soul,
lines.plainText: Then God take mercy on brave Talbot's soul

lines.text: And on his son young John, who two hours since
lines.plainText: And on his son young John who two hours since

lines.text: I met in travel toward his warlike father.
lines.plainText: I met in travel toward his warlike father

lines.text: This seven years did not Talbot see his son;
lines.plainText: This seven years did not Talbot see his son

lines.text: And now they meet where both their lives are done.
lines.plainText: And now they meet where both their lives are done

lines.text: Alas, what joy shall noble Talbot have
lines.plainText: Alas what joy shall noble Talbot have

lines.text: To bid his young son welcome to his grave?
lines.plainText: To bid his young son welcome to his grave

lines.text: Away! Vexation almost stops my breath,
lines.plainText: Away Vexation almost stops my breath

lines.text: That sunder'd friends greet in the hour of death.
lines.plainText: That sunder'd friends greet in the hour of death

lines.text: Lucy, farewell. No more my fortune can
lines.plainText: Lucy farewell No more my fortune can

lines.text: But curse the cause I cannot aid the man.
lines.plainText: But curse the cause I cannot aid the man

lines.text: Maine, Blois, Poictiers, and Tours, are won away,
lines.plainText: Maine Blois Poictiers and Tours are won away

lines.text: Long all of Somerset and his delay.
lines.plainText: Long all of Somerset and his delay

lines.text: Thus, while the vulture of sedition
lines.plainText: Thus while the vulture of sedition

lines.text: Feeds in the bosom of such great commanders,
lines.plainText: Feeds in the bosom of such great commanders

lines.text: Sleeping neglection doth betray to loss
lines.plainText: Sleeping neglection doth betray to loss

lines.text: The conquest of our scarce-cold conqueror,
lines.plainText: The conquest of our scarcecold conqueror

lines.text: That ever-living man of memory,
lines.plainText: That everliving man of memory

lines.text: Henry the Fifth. Whiles they each other cross,
lines.plainText: Henry the Fifth Whiles they each other cross

lines.text: Lives, honours, lands, and all hurry to loss.
